content: Humility is good for everyone; but it is an added jewel of immense beauty to the wealthy and powerful.
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation: While humility dignifies anyone, it shines most brightly when possessed by those who have the material or social power to dominate others.
practicalInsight: In any interaction today where you hold superior knowledge, authority, or leverage, lead with active listening and genuine gentleness.
reflectionPrompt: Where can I replace subtle assertiveness with heartfelt humility?
